tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Accent text and symbols in the aqua role: Clear and Plain button labels, links, selected values, today in pickers. Reads on `surface` and every surface container, milk included. Light aqua-40 / dark aqua-80.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on a solid `primary` fill (high-contrast liquid, reduce-transparency fills).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Solid aqua container for reduce transparency and flat tonal surfaces. Content on it is `on-primary-container`.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on `primary-container`.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Accent on `inverse-surface`, for actions in stock Material snackbars (aqua-80 light / aqua-40 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Accent text and symbols in the seafoam role, on `surface` and every surface container.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on a solid `secondary` fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Solid seafoam container. Content on it is `on-secondary-container`.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on `secondary-container`.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Accent text and symbols in the lavender role (assistant, voice), on `surface` and every surface container.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on a solid `tertiary` fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Solid lavender container. Content on it is `on-tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on `tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text and symbols (field errors, Delete in menus), on `surface` and every surface container.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on a solid `error` fill.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Solid error container. Content on it is `on-error-container`.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on `error-container`.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Material `background`, identical to `surface`. Sea Glass screens use `surface`; this exists for stock Material components.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on `background`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground for solid screens and content under milk panes.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmest solid surface, for stock Material components.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Brightest solid surface, for stock Material components.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest solid container. Reduce-transparency Milk, Clear and Pearl fill in light.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Low solid container; grouped backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Default solid container. Reduce-transparency Dry fill in dark.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: High solid container. Reduce-transparency Milk in dark, Dry in light.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Highest solid container. Reduce-transparency Well fill in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Material `surfaceVariant` for stock components (tracks, chips); Sea Glass components use wells instead. Content on it is `on-surface-variant`.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Material tonal-elevation tint; always follows `primary`.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and symbols on `surface`, every surface container, Milk, Well, Clear and Pearl. Light neutral-10 / dark neutral-90.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders (always full strength, never faded), metadata, plain icon buttons and leading field symbols, on `surface`, every surface container, Milk and Well.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Solid inverse surface for stock Material snackbars and tooltips; Sea Glass toasts use `ink`. Text on it is `inverse-on-surface`.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on `inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Meaningful boundaries: high-contrast and reduce-transparency rings on Clear, Pearl, Milk and Well; 3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and list dividers only; never the only cue for a control boundary.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind stock Material dialogs and sheets, applied at partial opacity.

tokens.name: on-glass
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on Glass and Frost in the aqua role (aqua-10 light / aqua-95 dark). Other roles use their own `<role>-10` / `<role>-95`.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on Fill liquid and Bead in the aqua role (white light / aqua-10 dark). Other roles: white / `<role>-10`.

tokens.name: on-pearl
tokens.usage: Content on Pearl knobs and markers, both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink pane body (toasts, plain tooltips): the top stop of the Ink gradient. Text on it is `on-ink`.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on `ink` toasts and tooltips.

tokens.name: disabled-content
tokens.usage: Content on Dry (disabled) glass: onSurface at 38%. The only faded text in the system; disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 1.5 dp focus rim that hugs the shape with no gap (aqua-60 at 85% light, aqua-80 at 95% dark), inside the `focus-halo` glow; other roles use their own tones. Dark: 9.9:1 on `surface`. Light: the rim alone is about 2.6:1 on `surface` (2.2:1 on `surface-container-highest`); the glow and bloom carry the indicator there, and high contrast switches to `focus-ring-high`.

tokens.name: focus-ring-high
tokens.usage: High-contrast focus ring, 3 dp (aqua-30 light / aqua-90 dark), separated from the element by `focus-gap-high`.

tokens.name: focus-gap-high
tokens.usage: The 2 dp separation ring between a high-contrast focus ring and the element.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Base colour of the aurora backdrop that glass is shown over in specimens (bundle `.sg-ground`). Not a UI surface.
